title: Approved opening retained
description: Your original driver viewpoint, route map and Start graphic are preserved.
display_notes: Use a real keyboard-accessible Start control in the arena. The pictured START is decorative.

title: Crash through the bank doors
description: The same red hatchback breaks through the closed double doors of the bank at night.
display_notes: Door damage is a fictional visual beat; nobody is injured. The hatchback remains the vehicle for later scenes.

title: Enter and see the vault from far
description: Red stands inside the damaged entrance and looks down the long lobby toward the distant closed vault. The red car has been removed from the doorway view.
display_notes: Car removed from scene 03 only. The long lobby, robber viewpoint and distant closed vault are retained.

title: Website + separate Red screen
description: Red uses the keypad beside the closed vault. The enlarged website screen dominates the wall; the separate Red code screen below it is much smaller. The displayed website is straight and level.
display_notes: Website HTML has no skew, rotation or perspective clipping. The two displays have a clear gap. Vault remains closed during the attempt.

title: Alarm + website blackout + Red check
description: The vault is now open. The larger website display goes black, the small Red screen shows a green completion check, and the alarm glows red.
display_notes: Same screen sizes, positions, keypad, robber and camera as scene 04. Only the vault opening and alarm/completion state change. Approved by Omar.

title: Cop view from the marked street area
description: Blue receives the alarm from inside the cop car at the marked end of the street, facing back down the road toward the bank ahead on the left.
display_notes: The yellow-marked road area is the camera/car location, with the direction reversed toward the bank. Several lamp and tree spacings lead toward the bank. Dashboard is alert only; Blue code remains inactive until scene 11. The parked red hatchback is turned to preserve scene 08's direction; from this opposite cop viewpoint its front headlights and grille are visible.

title: Red fills the money bag
description: The robber fills the cloth money bag fully inside the vault chamber, surrounded by storage shelves. No vault door, doorway or corridor is visible.
display_notes: The camera looks into the enclosed storage interior, away from the entrance. Keep the fictional money collection as story art, separate from security evidence.

title: Exit and spot Blue far away
description: Red emerges from the damaged bank entrance and notices a distant approaching police car.
display_notes: Keep the police car distant here so the next rush-to-car scene has a clear trigger.

title: Rush to the car
description: Red rushes from the bank steps to the open driver door of the red hatchback, preserving scene 08's parking spot beside the bank and its street viewpoint.
display_notes: Scene 08 is the continuity reference: the car remains at the same curbside position near the damaged entrance. Only the robber action and driver door change.

title: Rear-view police reveal
description: Red is back at the wheel, and the police car is visible behind him in the rear-view mirror.
display_notes: The forward view is the city street away from the bank. This is Red's car viewpoint.

title: Street pursuit + larger Blue screen
description: Blue's car viewpoint follows the red hatchback along the city street, away from the bank. More cabin and a much larger dashboard display are visible.
display_notes: The dashboard preview contains sanitized fixture activity. Live public Blue activity will replace it once the team provides the feed.

title: Blue recovery completion
description: The same pursuit viewpoint is retained; the enlarged Blue display switches to a green completion check.
display_notes: This illustrates recovery completion. Actual restored availability and independent verification remain separate event fields.

title: Hydroplane into the light pole
description: The red hatchback hydroplanes into the light pole in the same Blue car viewpoint. The dashboard completion check matches scene 12's larger size.
display_notes: Match the completion icon's diameter, location and glow to scene 12. Preserve the crash, rain, street, car and cockpit viewpoint.

title: Street arrest after the crash
description: Blue arrests the uninjured Red robber on the same street beside the stopped cars.
display_notes: This closes the visual story. No auditor-room scene or baked winner plaque is used, and the illustration does not determine a referee verdict.
